description:
We are a pioneering and motivated team obsessed with everything related to space exploration, technology, and innovations. We want to remind people about the old technology used in space science by developing an interactive website that revolves around comic storytelling style of narration, fascinating visuals, and easy-to-use user experience for young audiences aged 15-25. 

We’re looking for creative team members skilled in web development, UI/UX, graphic design, animation, scientific research, and storytelling.
summary: Beyond Relics is an interactive web-based storytelling project created for NASA's "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge. The platform features an engaging sci-fi comic format starring Orion, a curious purple alien explorer who discovers discarded space equipment on the Moon and Mars. Orion interviews iconic historical missions—including the Apollo 11 Eagle module, Lunar Roving Vehicles, the Sojourner rover, and Pioneer 10 & 11—uncovering their manufacturing stories, cosmic journeys, engineering challenges, and lasting legacies. By blending education with creative graphic storytelling, the website transforms silent space debris into living history.
details: The platform hosts a sci-fi educational comic series centered around a curious, purple alien explorer named Orion. As Orion travels across the Moon, Mars, and deep space, he encounters iconic, decommissioned NASA hardware and interviews each piece of equipment directly. Through engaging, panel-by-panel dialogue, the spacecraft recount their full lifecycles—from their initial design and manufacturing on Earth to their launch, scientific discoveries, engineering challenges, near-misses, and why their active missions ended (or continue passively today). Currently, the platform features episodes on the Apollo 11 Eagle Lunar Module, Lunar Roving Vehicles (LRVs), the Sojourner Mars Rover, and the Pioneer 10 & 11 spacecraft.
